capabilities: Scans vault and external folders for SKILL.md skills and commands
Browses, filters and edits skills in a side pane
Launches skills from ribbon buttons, command palette or right-click on files and selected text
Registers CLI harnesses and agents and runs skills through them
Schedules skills to run on a timer
extras: Desktop and macOS only for now. Schedules run only while Obsidian is open; runs missed while the laptop was asleep execute once after it wakes. Bundled setup skills help configure cmux and Ghostty.
motivation: The goal is more ownership and pruning of skills over time instead of collecting or building skills that aren't used regularly and aren't maintained.
problem: Skills and commands scattered across .claude/, .codex/, .cursor/ and marketplace folders are hard to see, edit or run from inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Terminal runs and session Connects open as new, named tabs in one cmux workspace
runs open as tabs (or windows) in your existing Ghostty via AppleScript

requires.name: CLI harness (claude, codex, opencode, ucode, Omnigent or a custom command)

summary: Side pane that collects SKILL.md skills and commands from vault and external folders and launches them through a chosen CLI harness.
